newsitem.title: POLAND: ADTRANZ, POLISH RAIL TO SIGN $200 MLN DEAL - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: ADTRANZ, POLISH RAIL TO SIGN $200 MLN DEAL - PAPER.

text.p: Adtranz, the joint venture of ABB Ltd and Daimler Benz AG , may sign a $200 million deal with Polish State Railways (PKP) for the delivery of electrical locomotives in November, a daily said on Monday.

"It is possible that this month the agreement with Adtranz for the delivery of modern electrical locomotives will be signed," the Rzeczpospolita business daily quoted PKP President Jan Janik as saying.

In September, the Polish privatisation ministry signed an initial agreement with Adtranz on selling 75 percent of rolling-stock maker Pafawag SA, on the condition that the Polish firm and PKP agree on a locomotive delivery programme.
Under the agreement, Adtranz would pay $3.7 million for a stake in ailing Pafawag bringing modern technology to Poland's only rolling-stock maker, and invest $28.1 million over the next six years.
Janik said PKP planned to invest eight billion zlotys for modernising its rolling-stock over the next five years.
